slides.texte_overlay:
7 habits that will make
you dangerously
attractive in your 20s
Train for strength, not just looks. Squats, deadlifts, pull-ups. A strong body moves with confidence, and that shows in everything you do.
Find a signature scent. One fragrance you wear often. A good smell becomes part of how people remember you. Start with one signature dish and practise it until you can make it without a recipe.
Learn to cook one impressive meal. Not complicated, just delicious. Inviting someone over and cooking well is quietly very attractive.
Speak kindly about your exes and old friends. How you talk about people from your past says a lot about who you are today.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A curious mind makes you more interesting than any outfit ever could.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A curious mind makes you more interesting than any outfit ever could.

slides.texte_overlay: Have something you're working toward. A business, a degree, a marathon. Ambition with a plan is one of the most attractive traits a man can have.
Take care of your teeth and skin. Floss, sunscreen, water. Small daily care shows, especially when you smile. Healthy, confident and easy to be around.
